storyline.real: In torrential rain Schumacher recovers from a poor start, takes the lead from Villeneuve on lap 13 and wins his first race for Ferrari by 45.3 s from Alesi.

hidden.label: Win without a single push lap

eras.briefing: Barcelona, 1996, in the rain. Schumacher starts third in his first season with Ferrari. You run him, leading by 31.1 s after 21 laps, with Villeneuve second and Alesi third. Bring the lead home.
